name: code-quality-agent
description: Validates TypeScript typing, accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), keyboard event trap, and responsive container structure.
rules: Ensure zero TypeScript diagnostics on tsc --noEmit
Verify keyboard handlers for Escape, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight on overlays
Ensure document.body.style.overflow locking on modal mount/unmount
Check all interactive elements have accessible aria labels
